Definition: Penuel or Peniel, a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Penuel or Peniel = "facing God"; n pr m; 1) a Benjamite, son of Shashak, brother of Iphedeiah of the family of Saul; 2) son of Hur, father of Gedor, and a descendant of Judah; n pr loc; 3) the place named by Jacob when he wrestled with God and located on the north bank of the Jabbok close to the Jordan
